newsitem.title: USA: Lucent wins $140 mln Taiwan supply contracts.
newsitem.headline: Lucent wins $140 mln Taiwan supply contracts.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said Tuesday it won two supply contracts worth more than $140 million from KG Telecom and Tuntex Telecom, two of Taiwan's wireless communications operators.

Lucent said it will supply the companies with wireless network infrastructure equipment including its 5ESS(R)-2000 mobile switching center system for personal communications, its Compact BTX-2000/2C base transceiver Station and the BCF-2000 base station controller.

In January, the two Taiwanese companies won licenses for wireless services as part of the nation's first wave of telecommnciations liberalization, the company said. Some eight licenses were awarded to six companies.
Lucent said the KG Telecom and Tuntex Telecom projects will be completed in two years.
